about.title: About me
about.intro: I’m a career-changing Frontend Web Developer focused on web development and design. I love bringing creative ideas to life through clean code—and seeing my creativity grow with every new possibility I discover. Right now, I’m soaking up as much knowledge as possible and building projects to launch my career as a Junior Developer.
about.location: I’m based in Meitingen (near Augsburg, Bavaria) and am open to remote opportunities and flexible, modern ways of working.
about.curiosity: Open-mindedly exploring new tech keeps my skills sharp—especially interactive UI/UX, motion design, and scroll-driven animations to bring web experiences to life.
about.problemSolving: With tricky bugs, I understand the root cause first, then aim for a clean, minimal-invasive solution and bounce ideas off the team—combining creativity, self-reliance, and collaboration in every challenge.

skills.title: My skills
skills.intro: From clean UI code and Angular to REST APIs and Scrum—here’s the toolkit I build with.
skills.outro: Always excited to pick up new tools—especially interactive UI, motion, and whatever the project calls for.

portfolio.intro: Check out some of my favorite builds—click around and see what I can do in action.

projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
projects.wickedWoods: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help the little witch survive the wicked woods by collecting potions and fending off dark creatures.
projects.daBubble: This App is a Slack Clone App. It revolutionizes team communication and collaboration with its intuitive interface, real-time messaging, and robust channel organization.

giuliano.text: Alica has an impressive eye for design paired with a genuinely structured approach to coding. She never just settles for a quick fix—she takes the time to understand the root cause and comes up with clean, thoughtful solutions. Her progress and curiosity make her a great asset to any frontend team.

patrick.text: Working with Alica on group projects was always super smooth and motivating. She brings great UI/UX ideas to the table, stays calm when tricky bugs pop up, and communicates clearly so the whole team stays on track.

neelima.text: Coming from C++, I was really impressed by how clean and well-organized Alicas frontend code is. She solves problems well, has a great sense for design, and working through ideas with her always improved our projects. Beyond her technical skills, Alica is a fantastic team player—she is always friendly, approachable, and brings a positive energy that lifts the entire team.
